name: Vitiel
source:
Scatterbrained and a bit dorky, Vitiel stuck to Lucius ever since they first met. Vitiel hopes one day for more breathing room to calmly explore this fascinating, human-cultivated world.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/poxni/incompatible-species-science-fiction-kinetic-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]

The pronouns used to refer to Vitiel (he, she, or they) are randomized in each playthrough.
